Disconnect the electrical connector for the passenger compartment air fan maximum speed relay

See J041 PASSENGER COMPARTMENT AIR FAN MAXIMUM SPEED RELAY

Connect a multimeter in ohmmeter mode between the following pins and measure:

  • Between pins 1 and 4 a resistance of between 272 and 408 mOhm.
  • Between pins 1 and 2 a resistance of between 0.688 and 1.032 Ohm.
  • Between pins 1 and 3 a resistance of between 2 and 3 Ohm.
